sections.heading: Teen and provisional licensing conditions
sections.markdown:
## Teen and provisional licensing conditions

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Georgia's described graduated licensing program moves teens aged 15 through 18 through 3 stages, with age, required preparation, demonstrated driving ability and responsible behavior controlling progression. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
An applicant younger than 18 needs a responsible adult present to sign the application and complete the required affidavit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A01
The signing responsible adult must be at least 18, be competent to verify the application and personally know the applicant. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A01
A parent or guardian signing as the responsible adult must provide acceptable records establishing the relationship, such as school or military records, tax information or a driving or identification credential. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A01
A social worker who has worked with the applicant may qualify as the responsible adult, with employee identification or an agency letter. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A01
A certified driving instructor may act for the parent, guardian or responsible adult when the authorization is supported by notarized documentation. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A01
An employee of the shelter where an applicant lives may qualify as the responsible adult with employee identification or a shelter letter. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A01
The handbook also allows a stepparent or another person identified through acceptable government or school evidence to serve as the responsible adult. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A01
A minor's school-related evidence may be a school-enrollment certificate, high-school diploma, special diploma, high-school-completion certificate or GED. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A01
An official sealed college or vocational transcript dated within the last 30 days is another listed school-evidence choice for a minor. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A01
A homeschool declaration of intent or an adult-literacy certificate showing current GED study are also listed alternatives to the minor's school-enrollment certificate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A01
DDS-approved driver education is required for a Class D provisional license at age 16 or 17. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A01
The graduated program starts with CP, the Class C instructional permit, for which an applicant may apply beginning at age 15. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A01
A first CP issuance requires the applicable REAL ID documentation, identity and lawful-presence evidence, Georgia residency, and the full Social Security number or evidence of ineligibility. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A01
A CP applicant must pass the vision screening and the knowledge test covering signs and road rules. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A01
The adult signing a minor's CP application gives consent and can revoke the permit before the holder reaches 18. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A01
A CP holder must be accompanied in the adjacent seat by a fit, capable Class C licensed driver aged at least 21 who can exercise control over the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=27]

Misconceptions: The adult who can sign an application and the person allowed to supervise a CP driver have different minimum ages and requirements.
Mnemonic: Age, adult, evidence, education, experience, restrictions.
Glossary: Graduated licensing is progression through conditional credential stages; revocation at an adult signer's request requires the prescribed form.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Permit duration, military exceptions, points, suspension and limited-permit policy retain current legal review.
